commands.stage: Verify required delivery files, strict UTF-8, JSON parse, final draft identity and separate word-count result
commands.cmd: $outDir = '<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\runs\D-Q02-revise-r1-v1'; $expectedFiles = @('draft-01.md','draft-02.md','draft-03.md','final.md','rationale.md','self-review.md','changes-and-source-checks.md','draft-01-check-voice.txt','draft-01-check-prose.txt','draft-02-check-voice.txt','draft-02-check-prose.txt','final-check-voice.txt','final-check-prose.txt','draft-01-word-count.json','draft-02-word-count.json','final-word-count.json','word-count.py','loaded-resources.json','input-file-hashes.json','executed-commands.json','failed-word-count-command.json','artifact-hashes.json','artifact-write-events.json'); $utf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true); foreach ($name in $expectedFiles) { $path = Join-Path $outDir $name; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Missing required artifact: $name" }; $content = $utf8.GetString([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path)); if ($name.EndsWith('.json')) { $null = $content | ConvertFrom-Json } }; $finalHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $outDir 'final.md') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; $draftHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $outDir 'draft-03.md') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; if ($finalHash -ne $draftHash) { throw 'Final does not match preserved draft 03' }; $counts = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $outDir 'final-word-count.json'), $utf8) | ConvertFrom-Json; if (-not ($counts.body_in_range -and $counts.one_body_paragraph)) { throw 'Final count failed' }; $report = [pscustomobject]@{ required_files_present=$expectedFiles.Count; strict_utf8_decode='passed'; json_parse='passed'; final_matches_draft_03=$true; final_sha256=$finalHash; body_words=$counts.body_words; attribution_heading_words=$counts.attribution_heading_words; body_paragraphs=$counts.body_paragraphs }; $json = $report | ConvertTo-Json; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $outDir 'completion-verification.json'), $json+[Environment]::NewLine, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); $json
